camera-stage-case.tagline_en: Source factory for professional camera, lens, lighting, drone, and broadcast equipment cases. 200+ foam layouts. IP67 + MIL-SPEC. 12h quote, 30-day delivery.
camera-stage-case.tagline_zh: 专业相机、镜头、灯光、无人机、广播设备防护箱源头工厂。200+ 泡沫布局。IP67 + MIL-SPEC。12h 报价，30 天交付。
camera-stage-case.brands_supported: Sony A7 IV / A7R V / A9 III / A1 / FX3 / FX6 / FX9 / Venice · Canon EOS R5 / R6 / R3 / C70 / C300 / C500 · Nikon Z6 III / Z8 / Z9 · Fujifilm X-H2S / GFX100 · Blackmagic Pocket 6K / URSA / Mini Pro 12K · RED Komodo / V-Raptor · ARRI Amira / Alexa Mini · DJI Ronin 4D / Inspire 3 / Mavic · Zhiyun Crane · Atomos / SmallHD monitors
camera-stage-case.video_prompt_template: Professional 6-second video: matte black plastic camera case opening on white background, custom-cut foam insert inside, soft studio lighting, slow dolly-in, depth of field, no text, 4K, photorealistic
use_cases: Mirrorless camera kit (Sony / Canon / Nikon / Fujifilm)
Cinema camera + matte box + follow focus + monitor
Drone (DJI Mavic / Phantom / Inspire) + 5 batteries + controller
Stage lighting (LED panel / moving head / controller)

drone-case.tagline_en: Hard cases for DJI / Autel / Parrot / Skydio drones, FPV gear, LiPo batteries, Gimbals. 200+ foam layouts. IP67 + MIL-SPEC.
drone-case.tagline_zh: DJI / Autel / Parrot / Skydio 无人机、FPV 装备、LiPo 电池、云台防护箱。200+ 泡沫布局。IP67 + MIL-SPEC。
drone-case.lipo_safety: Fire-retardant foam + vented valve, UN 3480/3481 compliant
drone-case.brands_supported: DJI Mavic / Phantom / Inspire / Matrice / FPV Avata · Autel EVO II / EVO Lite · Parrot Anafi · Skydio 2+ · Yuneec H520 · Walkera Voyager
drone-case.video_prompt_template: Professional 6-second video: matte black plastic drone case opening on a concrete hangar floor, DJI Mavic 3 + controller + 3 batteries nestled in custom-cut foam, slow pull-back, soft natural lighting, no text, 4K, photorealistic

military-tactical-case.tagline_en: MIL-STD-810H certified cases for military, law enforcement, first responders, defense. Weapon storage, NVG, comms, body armor, ammunition. Used by armed forces in 30+ countries.
military-tactical-case.tagline_zh: MIL-STD-810H 认证防护箱，适用于军警、急救人员、国防承包商。武器存储、夜视仪、通信、防弹衣、弹药。30 多个国家军队使用。
military-tactical-case.brands_supported: AR-15 / M4 / M16 / SCAR / AK-47 / MP5 · Benelli M4 · Remington 870 · Sig MCX · PVS-14 / PVS-31 / GPNVG-18 · ACOG / Aimpoint / EOTech · AN/PRC-152 / AN/PRC-163 · SAPI / ESAPI plates
military-tactical-case.video_prompt_template: Professional 6-second video: olive drab green tactical rifle case opening on desert sand, AR-15 + ACOG + suppressor + magazines in custom-cut foam, slow zoom out, golden hour lighting, no text, 4K, photorealistic

medical-case.tagline_en: WHO PQS / FDA / CE MDR certified cold chain and medical device transport cases. Vaccine, blood, biologic, pharmaceutical, organ transport. Validated 24-96h temperature maintenance.
medical-case.tagline_zh: WHO PQS / FDA / CE MDR 认证冷链和医疗器械运输防护箱。疫苗、血液、生物制剂、药品、器官运输。经验证 24-96 小时温度维持。
medical-case.brands_supported: Pfizer-BioNTech · Moderna · Johnson & Johnson · AstraZeneca · Sinovac · Sinopharm · GSK · Sanofi · Roche · Merck · Eli Lilly · AbbVie · BMS · Amgen
medical-case.video_prompt_template: Professional 6-second video: white medical-grade case opening on sterile lab bench, vaccine vials in temperature-controlled foam insert, soft clinical lighting, slow tilt up, no text, 4K, photorealistic

waterproof-case.tagline_en: IP67/IP68 waterproof cases for marine, fishing, diving, kayaking, outdoor adventure, expedition gear. Submersible to 5m. Salt-spray tested 96h.
waterproof-case.tagline_zh: IP67/IP68 防水防护箱，适用于海钓、钓鱼、潜水、皮划艇、户外探险。5 米潜水。96 小时盐雾测试。
waterproof-case.brands_supported: GoPro / DJI Osmo / Insta360 / Sony RX0 / Olympus TG · Garmin GPS · iPad / Surface · Dive lights / Regulators / BCDs · Fishing reels / Tackle boxes
waterproof-case.video_prompt_template: Professional 6-second video: yellow waterproof case being dropped from 1.5m onto wet concrete, slow motion splash, then opening to reveal dry camera inside, overcast natural lighting, no text, 4K, photorealistic

instrument-case.tagline_en: Custom foam-fitted cases for surveying, medical, optical, test & measurement, scientific instruments. Anti-static foam available. Sub-mm precision CNC routing.
instrument-case.tagline_zh: 为测绘、医疗、光学、测试测量、科学仪器定制的泡沫适配防护箱。可选防静电泡沫。亚毫米精度 CNC 加工。
instrument-case.brands_supported: Leica · Trimble · Topcon · Sokkia · Nikon · Spectra · Faro · Riegl · Hexagon · Olympus · Zeiss · Keyence · Mitutoyo
instrument-case.video_prompt_template: Professional 6-second video: precision foam insert being CNC-milled, then camera pulls back to show fully populated case with surveying instruments, soft workshop lighting, no text, 4K, photorealistic
